reviews.title: Artistry & Perfection
reviews.text: This app has everything you’d need in a journaling app. Lots of customization features including entry backgrounds and templates, rich text, media management, sync, and a beautiful design with a seamless user experience.  Even paid apps don’t come with as much functionality sometimes, and this is entirely free, as I see. My only suggestion: instead of showing “default user”, let us customize our journal user profile. :)
